DiscordAdapter — ChannelPort for Discord.

Receiving: Discord gateway WebSocket runs in a dedicated OS thread. The thread pushes DiscordRawEvent values to a module-level Channel. The daemon calls tryRecvEvent() (non-blocking) in its main loop.

Sending: HTTP REST API (POST /channels/{id}/messages). DM channel IDs are fetched on first send and cached.

Slash commands:

/continue <code>
— link Discord identity to an existing session

Registered at startup via registerSlashCommands().

Blocking model: the gateway thread blocks on WebSocket recv (1 s timeout). Provider LLM calls (max ~10 s) block the event loop but not this thread. Discord heartbeat interval is ~41 s; occasional missed beats are tolerated.

Module-level channel — opened once, valid for daemon lifetime.Buffer for messages received before gateway is ready.

DiscordEventKind = enum
  deMessage,                ## regular DM or guild message
  deInteraction,            ## slash command interaction (code already extracted)
  deModalRequest,           ## /continue slash cmd without code → need to show modal
  deButtonClick              ## component button click — content = custom_id
Source   Edit   
DiscordRawEvent = object
  kind*: DiscordEventKind
  discordUserId*: string
  content*: string           ## message text OR interaction option value
  channelId*: string         ## Discord channel ID (for messages)
  messageId*: string
  interactionId*: string
  interactionToken*: string
